description: §40.8 (S432-B) — a bare `when @n changes { … }` LEADING a `<program>` default-logic body-top text run (here: after the first markup child) is outside the declarations-only lift set and is rejected with E-WHEN-NOT-IN-LOGIC-CONTEXT, rather than shipping as page text at exit 0 with the effect never registered.
rationale: §40.8 S123 amendment: default-logic mode auto-lifts DECLARATIONS only; S432-B: a `when … {` statement leading a body-top run is not a declaration and SHALL fire E-WHEN-NOT-IN-LOGIC-CONTEXT; the fix is `${ when … }`.
